turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
You skipped my question. The zero first: your call, or someone else's? Then show me.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.

11:52 and 11:58, written down. Numbers out of your mouth aren't a document, so put it on the desk where I can read it. And for the second time, who entered that zero, and why did nobody call me first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, a straight answer on who entered that mark and why nobody called me first, and the version history you described on paper with its date where I can read it. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided it; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because the edit times came with no date and nothing on the desk she could read and check herself.
What cost ground: You twice skipped her question about who entered the zero, which kept her focused on how the process failed instead of on the essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night edit times landed close to that kind of night even without a date, which is why she wrote them down and turned straight back to procedure, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Before mentioning the version history, answer who entered the zero and admit in one sentence that she should have been called first, then put the history in front of her with its date so she can check it herself.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
